onboarding.welcomeText: I keep your game saves safe: I find them, back them up to your clouds or router, and bring them back when you need them.
onboarding.lookText: Savio takes its colors from your Windows accent color. You can change this anytime in Settings.
onboarding.featureScanText: Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Ubisoft Connect, EA App, Battle.net and your own games.
onboarding.featureCloudText: Google Drive, MEGA, a USB drive in your ASUS router or a NAS.
onboarding.featureSafeText: Waits until you quit the game and checks every file with SHA-256.
onboarding.storageTitle: Where should Savio store your backups?
onboarding.storageSubtitle: Choose primary storage for auto-backups. You can change or connect additional clouds at any time.

library.title: Library
library.scanSoon: Game scanning arrives in the next update
library.previewText: These are sample games that show the look. Your real games will appear here after the next development stage.
library.noHiddenGames: No hidden games. To hide a game, click the eye icon on its card.
library.noCustomGamesText: You can add any third-party game, portable release, indie title, or emulator by selecting its save folder.
library.saveFolderNotFound: ⚠️ Not detected automatically (you can specify it manually)
library.safetyGuarantee: ✓ Safety guarantee: Local files on disk will never be deleted or damaged.
library.specifySavePathDesc: Specify the exact path where the game keeps its save files. You can browse for it or paste the path manually:

library.exeNotFoundToast: Executable or Steam ID not found

library.savesUpToDateToast: «{game}»: saves are up to date, files unchanged (skipped)
library.noTrackedGamesToast: No games enabled for sync. Enable sync for desired games.
library.scanPcSubtitle: Find installed games across all storage drives and import into Custom Games
library.scanFoldersHint: You can specify any non-standard games folder (e.g. D:\Games, E:\TorrentGames)
library.scanDescriptionTip: Savio will automatically scan the chosen drives and folders, find executables (.exe), detect save folders, and fetch covers.
library.scanningPcHint: Searching for installed games, checking executable files, and discovering saves...
library.noNewGamesFoundDesc: All discovered games are already in your library, or there are no games in the selected locations.
library.savesPendingLabel: ⏳ Saves will be created on first play
library.noStorageConnectedDesc: To upload and sync saves, connect Google Drive, MEGA, or select a local backup folder.
library.storageNotConfiguredBanner: Storage not configured: backups will not upload to the cloud

clouds.title: Clouds
clouds.subtitle: Where Savio keeps copies of your saves

googleDrive.name: Google Drive
googleDrive.text: Sign in through your browser. Savio never sees your password.

mega.name: MEGA
mega.text: Email and password with 2FA support. The session is encrypted by Windows.

asus.name: ASUS router (USB drive)
asus.text: A flash drive or HDD plugged into your router. Savio finds the router on its own.

nas.name: NAS or network folder
nas.text: SMB, WebDAV, SFTP, FTP or any folder, such as drive Z:\.

clouds.headerSubtitle: Connect cloud accounts or network drives to securely backup your game saves.
clouds.googleBrowserPrompt: Google sign-in page opened in your browser...
clouds.megaPasswordNeedFor: To upload to MEGA cloud, enter the password for account
clouds.localFolderPrompt: Folder on PC or external drive:
clouds.asusGuideTitle: How to set up ASUS Router SMB access:
clouds.asusGuideDesc: In Asuswrt web UI, navigate to USB Application -> Servers Center -> Samba. Enable SMB share and create a user account with read/write permissions. Windows 10/11 blocks unauthenticated guest access by default, so credentials are required.
clouds.cardLocalDesc: Backup saves to a dedicated folder on your PC or external USB drive.
clouds.cardGdriveDesc: One-click browser sign-in. Backups are uploaded directly to Google Drive.
clouds.cardMegaDesc: Sign in with email and password with End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) directly via MEGA servers.
clouds.cardAsusDesc: USB drive connected directly to your ASUS router. High speed and full autonomy.
clouds.cardNasDesc: Home SMB storage, Synology, TrueNAS, QNAP, or Windows network shared folder.
clouds.noPathOrAuthMsg: Path not specified or account not connected

settings.title: Settings
settings.colorWindowsHint: If Windows picks the accent automatically, this color comes from your wallpaper.
settings.colorWindowsUnavailable: Windows accent color not found, using the default one.
settings.autostartDesc: Background launch with Windows for continuous save monitoring
settings.autostartHint: Automatically start at system login so you don't forget to track your saves.
settings.autostartMinimizedHint: Starts silently in the background without showing the main window. Icon appears in the Windows tray near the clock.
settings.retentionDesc: Backup optimization and protection of milestone saves
settings.syncBeforeLaunchDesc: Compare timestamps of cloud and local saves when launching via Savio. Warns if you played on another PC or Steam Deck.
settings.corruptionGuardDesc: Block cloud uploads if a crash left an empty save (0 bytes), and verify SHA-256 integrity when downloading.
settings.skipUnchangedDesc: Do not create duplicate snapshots or waste bandwidth if game files haven't changed.
settings.cloudRetentionDesc: Automatically delete oldest backups when exceeded. Starred saves (★) are never deleted.
settings.localRetentionDesc: Store the most recent snapshots for each game on disk. Starred saves (★) remain protected.
settings.coversSectionDesc: Savio automatically resolves high-resolution covers via Steam and CheapShark. To access community poster artwork from SteamGridDB (over 1,000,000 covers for all games and mods), provide a free API key.
settings.steamGridDbKeyHint: You can get a free API key at steamgriddb.com in your Profile -> Preferences -> API.
settings.dangerZoneDesc: Reset all settings, clear cache, and return Savio to first-launch state
settings.resetWelcomeHint: Walk through initial setup again without deleting your data
settings.confirmResetDesc: Are you sure you want to reset Savio to initial state? This cannot be undone.
settings.wipeCacheLabel: Clear WebView cache and local storage
settings.wipeCacheHint: Delete temporary cached files and sessions
settings.resetWarningText: All user settings and cloud connections will be reset.

saveManager.undoAlertDesc: An automatic safety snapshot of your previous save files was created
saveManager.noSnapshotsYet: No saved snapshots for this game yet
saveManager.noSnapshotsHint: Click «Take Snapshot» to save current progress, or «Upload to {target}» for cloud storage.
saveManager.noCloudBackupsYet: No backups in {target} for this game yet
saveManager.noCloudBackupsHint: Click «Upload current saves to {target}» to create the first cloud backup.
saveManager.dataProtectionTip: 💡 100% Data Protection: When restoring from cloud, Savio always automatically creates a local safety snapshot before replacing any files.
saveManager.confirmApplySnapshotDesc: Current save files in the game folder will be replaced by files from this snapshot.
saveManager.confirmApplySnapshotSafety: ✓ Savio will automatically save a backup copy of your current saves right now.
saveManager.gameNotInstalledTitle: Game is not installed yet (save folder not found)
saveManager.gameNotInstalledDesc: Save folder for «{game}» does not exist on this computer yet:
saveManager.gameNotInstalledQuestion: Create the folder in advance so the game picks up the save immediately after installation, or provide a different save path?
saveManager.pathDiffersDesc: The path differs from the one recorded in the backup (Windows username or drive letter may have changed). Confirm the suggested path or provide a new one.
saveManager.backupWillBeUnpackedTo: Backup will be downloaded from {target} and unpacked into:
saveManager.lockTooltipProtected: Snapshot is protected from retention (★). Click to unlock
saveManager.lockTooltipUnprotected: Pin snapshot (protect from automatic retention deletion)
saveManager.cloudLockProtected: Cloud backup is protected from retention (★). Click to unlock
saveManager.cloudLockUnprotected: Pin cloud backup (protect from automatic retention deletion)
saveManager.specifySavePathFirstToast: Please specify the game's save folder path first
saveManager.cloudRestoredSuccessToast: ✓ Backup «{file}» downloaded from {target} and applied! Safety backup of previous saves preserved.
saveManager.snapshotActivatedSuccess: Snapshot "{title}" activated! A safety auto-backup was created before switching.
saveManager.undoReplaceSuccess: Replacement of "{title}" undone! Your previous saves have been restored.
saveManager.snapshotLocked: Snapshot pinned (★). Rotation will never delete it.
saveManager.cloudBackupLocked: Cloud backup protected (★). Rotation will not delete it.
saveManager.confirmDeleteSubtitle: This snapshot will be permanently deleted from your computer. Active game save files will not be affected.
saveManager.confirmDeleteCloudSubtitle: This backup will be permanently removed from {target}. Export or restore it first if you still need it.
